title: Boosting Adversarial Robustness and Generalization with Dictionary Structure
abstract: arXiv:2502.00834v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This work investigates a novel approach to boost adversarial robustness and generalization by incorporating structural prior into the design of deep learning models. Specifically, our study surprisingly reveals that existing dictionary learning-inspired convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are robust against random noise but remain highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks. To address this, we propose Elastic Dictionary Learning Networks (EDLNets), a novel ResNet architecture that significantly enhances adversarial robustness and generalization. Extensive and reliable experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in adversarial robustness across multiple datasets, backbone architectures, and threat models. translated_title: 利用字典结构提升对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力
translated_abstract: 本工作研究了一种通过在深度学习模型设计中引入结构先验来提升对抗鲁棒性和泛化能力的新方法。具体而言，我们的研究令人惊讶地发现，现有的受字典学习启发的卷积神经网络（CNN）虽然对随机噪声具有鲁棒性，但仍然极易受到对抗攻击的影响。为解决这一问题，我们提出了弹性字典学习网络，这是一种新颖的ResNet架构，能够显著增强对抗鲁棒性和泛化能力。大量且可靠的实验表明，该方法在多个数据集、骨干网络架构和威胁模型下均实现了一致的对抗鲁棒性提升。据我们所知，这是首个发现并验证字典结构能够在强自适应攻击下可靠地增强深度学习鲁棒性的工作，为未来研究开辟了一个有前景的方向。
tldr: 该论文提出弹性字典学习网络，首次验证了字典结构能够在强自适应对抗攻击下可靠地提升深度学习模型的对抗鲁棒性与泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Elastic Dictionary Learning Networks (EDLNets), a novel ResNet architecture that, for the first time, discovers and validates that dictionary structure can reliably enhance adversarial robustness and generalization of deep learning models under strong adaptive attacks.
